passage: NIE11 (Nature Neurosci 14:1105, full text read via author-hosted PDF), p.1105: "To support this claim, they needed to report a statistically significant interaction (between amount of training and type of mice), but instead they reported that one effect was statistically significant, whereas the other effect was not." passage: NIE11 (Nature Neurosci 14:1105, full text read via author-hosted PDF), p.1105: "A fictive example would be 'Hippocampal firing synchrony correlated with memory performance in the placebo condition (r = 0.43, P = 0.01), but not in the drug condition (r = 0.19, P = 0.21)'."
